Proposition
[Coercive Hessian estimate] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0015, cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0016 1. Proposition 2.2\group section-2

Let $M^n$ be complete, and $\Ric _M \geq (m-1)H$. Then for all $x, r$ \begin{equation} \tag {2.43} \| Hg\| ^2_{B_{r/2}(x)} \le 4\| \Delta g\| ^2_{B_r(x)} + \frac{24}{r^2}\| dg\| ^2_{B_r(x)} - 2(n-1)H\| \psi \, dg\| ^2_{B_r(x)}. \end{equation}

Let $A(r,\theta ), \mathcal{Q}^H(r)$ be as in (1.28). Given $\epsilon > 0$ and $H$, we define a refinement of the injectivity angle by letting $\widetilde{\omega }(H,\epsilon ,r,x)$ be the angular measure of the set $\Omega ^H(\epsilon )$ of initial tangent vectors to geodesics $\gamma $ from $x$ such that $\gamma |_{[0,r]}$ is minimal and

\begin{equation} \tag {2.44} \frac{A(s,\theta )}{\mathcal{Q}^H(s)} \ge \epsilon ,\qquad 0 \le s \le r, \end{equation}

at $\gamma (s)$. Note that for all $H$, $\widetilde{\omega }(H,0,r,x)=\widetilde{\omega }(r,x)$. Let $\nabla ^i g$ denote the $i$-th covariant derivative of $g$.
